provenance.source: orrery_persistd::intent::tests::emit_ramp_artifact, BaselineIntentValidator in shadow over a fixture epoch of 7 witnesses
provenance.note: Simulated traffic, not a fleet. Clause (e)'s W term is meaningless here by construction: the clock advances 10 ms per intent inside one fixture epoch's 60 s usability window, so W is under a minute rather than the 30 days a production leg needs. Everything else — fp_count, coverage and its denominator, |H|, account spread — is measured from the same shadow arm a deployment would run.
